headline: Privacy-safe attention and destination evidence are exact-staging green, with the scheduled refresh regression closed at the shared runner.

items.title: Attention pressure became public-safe evidence
items.insight: Automatic prompts now produce only post-consent fixed-vocabulary groups and publish nothing below a 20-claim privacy floor.

items.title: Canonical destinations gained uncertainty-honest reachability
items.insight: A deterministic bounded sample distinguishes repeat-observed dead links from auth walls, timeouts, rate limits, and transient provider failures.

items.title: CTA readiness stopped presenting stale evidence as current
items.insight: Current, aging, stale, and absent states now share one deterministic contract across the readiness receipt and status page.

items.title: The repeated Refresh Live Data failure is regression-locked
items.insight: Derived-build steps can declare explicit arguments; the News Desk producer now runs in deterministic rebuild mode and the exact 29-step profile passes.

followUps: Generalize mode-required CLI validation across derived-build profiles.
Expose destination unknown streak and last-known-good age without converting unknown to pass.
blockers: Identity/auth surfaces remain held on Obelisk relying-party registration and the founder passkey ceremony; scoped candidate promotion does not resolve them.
